Fields.Name: Reverb Type
Fields.Description: Reverb type set when this row matches.

Fields.Name: Condition: Indoor/Outdoor
Fields.Description: 0: only matches outdoors. 1: only indoors (including half indoors). -1: either.

Fields.Name: Condition: Evaluation Distance A
Fields.Description: Condition: Evaluation distance number A to use (-1: invalid)

Fields.Name: Condition: Evaluation Distance B
Fields.Description: Condition: Evaluation distance number B to be used (-1: invalid)

Fields.Name: Condition: Evaluation Distance A - Min
Fields.Description: Condition A matches when the evaluation distance is at least this (m). Below 0: no condition A.

Fields.Name: Condition: Evaluation Distance A - Max
Fields.Description: Condition A matches when the evaluation distance is at most this (m). Below 0: no condition A.

Fields.Name: Condition: Evaluation Distance B - Min
Fields.Description: Condition B matches when the evaluation distance is at least this (m). Below 0: no condition B.

Fields.Name: Condition: Evaluation Distance B - Max
Fields.Description: Condition B matches when the evaluation distance is at most this (m). Below 0: no condition B.

Fields.Name: Condition: No Hit Minimum
Fields.Description: Only matches when the number of no-hit points is at least this: kept collision points of rays that hit nothing, hit beyond the common distance limit or hit outdoor collision (averaged over the last 10 updates). Below 0: no condition.
